description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's ref format checking functionality. It defines functions to test valid and invalid ref names and runs a series of test cases to verify the behavior of 'git check-ref-format' under various conditions.

methods.name: valid_ref
methods.description: Function to test valid reference names with optional parameters.

methods.name: invalid_ref
methods.description: Function to test invalid reference names with optional parameters.

methods.name: valid_ref_normalized
methods.description: Function to test that a reference name simplifies to a normalized form.

methods.name: invalid_ref_normalized
methods.description: Function to test that a reference name is rejected in normalized form.
